sn56.5:1.1: abhisambojjhiṁsu → abhisambujjhiṁsu (bj, sya-all) | yathābhūtaṁ abhisambojjhiṁsu → yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṁsu (pts); yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti (pts) | Ye → B1 adds pi. (pts note) | abhisambujjhiṁsu → B1 -sambojjh- always; the end of this number in B1 only. (pts note)
sn56.5:1.2: abhisambojjhissanti → abhisambujjhissanti (bj, sya-all) | -abhisambujjhissanti → complete in B1 missing in S1-3. (pts note)
sn56.5:1.3: abhisambojjhanti → abhisambujjhanti (bj, sya-all) | ye → ye pi (pts) | yathābhūtaṁ abhisambojjhanti → yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti (pts) | pi → missing in S1-3. (pts note) | abhisambujjhanti → B1 abhisambojjhanti. (pts note)
sn56.5:2.2: paṭipadā → patipadā (pts) | la → S1-3 have sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni--ayaṁ instead of katamāni- (pts note)
sn56.5:2.5: abhisambojjhanti → abhisambujjhanti (bj) | abhisambojjhanti tasmātiha → abhisambujjhanti tasmā tiha (sya-all)
sn56.5:3.1: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti → dukkhanirodhayāminī patipadā ti (pts) | karaṇīyoti pañcamaṁ → karaṇīyo (pts)
